dct_title_s: Central African Republic - Subnational Edge-matched Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Central African Republic administrative level 0-3 and Bangui level 4 gazetteer, shapefiles, geodatabase, and geoservice. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-caf); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These layers are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Central African Republic - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-caf) tables using the ADM0, ADM1, ADM2, and ADM3_PCODE fields.
